title: Finite exact realization of normalized coefficient Koszul cones
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative Noetherian ring, J an ideal, U an object of the small pro-etale site, r a natural number, a:Fin r -> A with span(a)=J, and R the completed coefficient ring sheaf restricted to U [def-sfb-adic-residue-quotient-tensor-tower]. Supply algebraic Koszul augmentations epsilonA_n to A/J^(n+1)[0], exterior diagonal transitions tA_nm with entries a_i^(m-n), quotient transitions qA_nm normalized after the quotient map, and their strict commuting squares, as in [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-koszul-augmentation-pro-zero]. Let epsilon be any normalized coefficient augmentation of [lem-sfb-adic-residue-koszul-coefficient-augmentation]. There is an additive exact functor E from A-modules to R-module sheaves and, at each n, an isomorphism from the termwise E-image of the algebraic augmentation cone to the n-th actual strict coefficient augmentation cone. For every n<=m this isomorphism intertwines E of the cone map of the supplied strict algebraic square with the actual strict coefficient cone transition. There is no tensoring by an arbitrary complex, pro-zero assertion, or derived-limit assertion.

source.place: proof of lemma-naive-completion (099M), finite coefficient realization; more-algebra.tex, lemma-sequence-Koszul-complexes; algebraization.tex, lemma-derived-completion-koszul (0A0E).

proof.text: Obtain exact coefficient realization E, regular-module normalization c and quotient isomorphisms q from the scalar/quotient realization lemma. Apply the independent finite exterior scalar realization lemma to this E and c, obtaining levelwise Koszul isomorphisms eK with transition and empty-coordinate compatibility.

Extend each algebraic quotient single complex to integer degrees, use the standard extendSingleIso and singleMapHomologicalComplex comparisons, and then q to obtain eQ. Compute its degree-zero component. Precompose the augmentation comparison with c and the invertible empty exterior coordinate; the supplied algebraic augmentation formula and the two unit normalizations prove equality. Maps into a degree-zero single complex are determined by that component.

The algebraic augmentations are degreewise epimorphisms: degree zero is a quotient projection composed with the exterior zero equivalence, and all other target degrees vanish. Extension preserves this property; exact E preserves the epimorphisms.

Apply additiveConeFamilyComparison with the supplied strict algebraic squares, the augmentation comparison, eK transition compatibility and the proved realized epimorphisms. Its complete generic proof derives quotient-transition compatibility by epimorphism cancellation and supplies the required strict cone comparisons and naturality.

proof_origin.place: Finite scalar realization and finite Koszul coordinates, followed by proved degree-zero augmentation identification, epimorphism cancellation and strict cone naturality.

theorem adicResidue_koszul_coefficient_cone_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (J : Ideal A) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = J)
    (εA : ∀ n : ℕ, ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      (ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1))))
    (tA : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
      (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (m + 1)) ⟶
        ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (n + 1))))
    (qA : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
      ((ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (m + 1))) ⟶
        (ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1)))))
    (hεA : ∀ n, (εA n).f 0 = ModuleCat.ofHom
      (((Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1)).mkQ.comp
        (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A)).toLinearMap))
    (htA : ∀ n m h k, (tA n m h).f k = ModuleCat.ofHom
      (exteriorPower.map k
        (Finsupp.linearCombination A (fun i ↦ Finsupp.single i (a i ^ (m - n))))))
    (hqA : ∀ n m h,
      ModuleCat.ofHom ((Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (m + 1)).mkQ ≫ (qA n m h).f 0 =
        ModuleCat.ofHom ((Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1)).mkQ)
    (hc : ∀ n m h,
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap (tA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ≫
        HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA n) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat =
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA m) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ≫
        HomologicalComplex.extendMap (qA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) :
    let R := (completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J).over U
    let b := fun i ↦ ringedKoszulSliceSection
      (completed (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J)
      (algebraSection (coefficientMap (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J)
        (a i)) U
    ∀ (ε : ringedKoszulDualTower R r b ⟶ adicResidueQuotientCoefficientTower X J U)
      (_hε : ∀ n : ℕ, ringedKoszulDualUnit R r b n ≫ ε.app (op n) =
        adicResidueQuotientCoefficientUnit X J U n),
    ∃ (E : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A ⥤ Mod R) (_hadd : E.Additive)
      (_hlim : PreservesFiniteLimits E) (_hcolim : PreservesFiniteColimits E)
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA n) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)) ≅
          (CochainComplex.mappingCone
            ((HomologicalComplex.functorEquivalence
              (Mod R) (.up ℤ) ℕᵒᵖ).inverse.map ε)).asFunctor.obj
              (op n)),
      ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
        (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.mapArrowHom
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA m) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA n) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
            (fun j : ℤ ↦ ⟨j - 1, sub_add_cancel j 1⟩)
            (Arrow.homMk
              (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (tA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
              (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (qA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
              (hc n m h))) ≫ (e n).hom =
        (e m).hom ≫
          (CochainComplex.mappingCone
            ((HomologicalComplex.functorEquivalence
              (Mod R) (.up ℤ) ℕᵒᵖ).inverse.map ε)).asFunctor.map
              (homOfLE h).op
